document.about: FDA Laboratory Information Bulletin 4650 (Adobe Paper Capture). Its Attachment C lists GC-MS/MS transitions over six pages under a two-row header, both rows bold and unshaded: `MRM | Ret. | Quant MRM | Qual MRM` over `Start | Time | Compound | Q1 | Q3 | CE | Q1 | Q3 | CE`.

checks.issue: The header's second row was read as data, so Compound, Q1, Q3 and CE named no column in any part.
